comment: Communities/districts along the Airport Run (Norman Manley → Ocho Rios). Real-world lat/lon, projected into world space by recognition.ts. Entries marked needs_owner_review need confirmation against lived knowledge — OSM data alone is not authoritative for exact community boundaries.

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Roundabout entry from the Palisadoes into Kingston.

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Industrial/residential district along Windward Road heading into Kingston.

communities.name: Kingston
communities.note: Capital city. Route threads through downtown and uptown.

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major Kingston junction — Mountain View Ave meets central Kingston.

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Business district — Trafalgar Road / Knutsford Boulevard area.

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Busy commercial hub; the clock tower is a landmark.

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Former capital of Jamaica. Route passes on the bypass.

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Village at the entrance to the famous Bog Walk Gorge.

communities.name: Flat Bridge
communities.note: Iconic low bridge over the Rio Cobre in the gorge.

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Town on the far side of the Bog Walk Gorge, near the alumina plant.

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: St. Catherine market town; famous for the Linstead Market folk song.

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Small town in St. Ann on the plateau.

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Famous roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival.

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Bamboo-canopied gully road descending to the north coast.

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Tourist town on the north coast. The run ends at Dunn's River Falls.
